subject: Operations
title: FedEx and the Holiday Meltdown
description: A quick win: understand FedEx and the Holiday Meltdown.

hook.text: Christmas 2013: FedEx and UPS failed to deliver millions of packages on time. Presents arrived after the holiday.

buildup.text: Online shopping surged beyond forecasts. Last-minute orders overwhelmed sorting hubs and delivery networks.

discovery.text: Carriers had capacity for projected volumes but not the actual spike. Forecasting missed e-commerce's acceleration.

twist.text: Retailers had promised delivery dates they couldn't control—the carrier's failure became the retailer's broken promise.

climax.text: After 2013, carriers invested billions in automation and surge capacity. Amazon began building its own delivery network.

punchline.text: Promise a date, own the delivery—or someone else will.

quiz.question: What caused the 2013 holiday delivery failure?
options: Online shopping surged beyond capacity forecasts
